headword: {人間国宝|にんげんこくほう}

definitions.explanation: An informal title for individuals officially designated as holders of Important Intangible Cultural Properties by the Japanese government. These are master practitioners of traditional arts and crafts, including kabuki, pottery, weaving, and swordsmithing.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{人間国宝|にんげんこくほう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{認定|にんてい}→認定：06108_nintei⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: He was designated a Living National Treasure.

examples.japanese: {人間国宝|にんげんこくほう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{陶芸家|とうげいか}→陶芸家：20904_tougeika⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{作品|さくひん}→作品：02776_sakuhin⟧⟦{展|てん}→〜展：28468_ten⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|ひら}いた→開く：01979_hiraku⟧。
examples.english: A ceramicist who is a Living National Treasure held an exhibition.

examples.japanese: ⟦{伝統|でんとう}{芸能|げいのう}→伝統芸能：15098_dentougeinou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{守|まも}る→守る：01986_mamoru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、{人間国宝|にんげんこくほう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{技|わざ}→技：02172_waza⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{次|つぎ}→次：00819_tsugi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{世代|せだい}→世代：05102_sedai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{伝|つた}える→伝える：01220_tsutaeru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{重要|じゅうよう}→重要：01575_juuyou⟧だ。
examples.english: To preserve traditional performing arts, it is important to pass on the skills of Living National Treasures to the next generation.

notes:
USAGE:
{人間国宝|にんげんこくほう} is the popular name for holders of {重要無形文化財|じゅうようむけいぶんかざい} (Important Intangible Cultural Properties). The system was established under the 1950 Cultural Properties Protection Act. Designees receive an annual stipend to support their work and the transmission of their skills.

Fields include traditional performing arts (⟦{歌舞伎|かぶき}→歌舞伎：04455_kabuki⟧, ⟦{能|のう}→能：01927_nou⟧, ⟦{文楽|ぶんらく}→文楽：13156_bunraku⟧), crafts (⟦{陶芸|とうげい}→陶芸：04449_tougei⟧, {染織|せんしょく}, {漆芸|しつげい}), and other traditional skills.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {人間国宝|にんげんこくほう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{認定|にんてい}→認定：06108_nintei⟧⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧: to be designated a Living National Treasure
- {人間国宝|にんげんこくほう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{技|わざ}→技：02172_waza⟧: skills of a Living National Treasure
- {人間国宝|にんげんこくほう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{作品|さくひん}→作品：02776_sakuhin⟧: works by a Living National Treasure
